recentItems.title: SpaceX BETRAYAL? Starlink SHUTS OFF Ukrainian Interceptor Drones Mid-Combat!
recentItems.description:
Starlink restrictions for the Ukrainian Armed Forces have disrupted drone missions and could complicate the interception of jet-powered Shahed drones. SpaceX introduced speed limits for Starshield without prior warning to Ukrainian forces. Meanwhile, "Operation Vivaldi" resulted in the liberation of 277 km² of territory, while industrial facilities and an oil terminal burn inside Russia. Following a strike on Kyiv, 600,000 consumers were left without power. Zelenskyy urges for more sanctions and Patriot missiles while addressing US pressure over attacks on Russian oil refineries. Also in this episode: Russian diesel exports, Keith Kellogg's stance, Macron's reaction, and the failure of the energy truce. Why are partners calling for increased pressure on the Kremlin?!

recentItems.title: "THIS IS A BETRAYAL OF INTERESTS!": US Politicians Revolt Over Putin | UK Steps Up to Help Ukraine
recentItems.description:
Air defense for Ukraine: The UK accelerates system deliveries, while the EU has provided nearly €3 billion for drones and urgent military needs. In London, Zelenskyy confirmed readiness for a ceasefire and met with King Charles III. Meanwhile, Russia attacked the energy grid with 39 ballistic missiles and over 120 drones. The President urged Trump to tighten sanctions and provide Patriot missiles. US senators demand the cancellation of the deal regarding Russian diesel. Also in this episode — "Operation Vivaldi": Ukrainian troops liberated over 100 km² and three villages, foiled the Russian offensive, and relieved pressure on Kupiansk. Details in the video.

recentItems.title: "Fields ARE LITTERED with the Dead!" Commander Fedorenko Reveals Truth About Putin's Assaults
recentItems.description:
Ukrainian forces disrupt the Russian offensive near Kostiantynivka, Pokrovsk, and Huliaipole, while advancing near Orikhiv. Ukrainian drones destroy enemy artillery, transport, and UAV launch sites, while Special Operations Forces set up ambushes behind enemy lines. Yuriy Fedorenko, commander of the "Achilles" Brigade, describes how Russians infiltrate between positions in small groups to create the illusion of encirclement. How do the Defense Forces counter this tactic, cut off enemy logistics, and hold the front line? The conversation also covers covert mobilization in Russia, enemy losses, Ukrainian military training, army reforms, and the role of partner support in strengthening strikes against Russia.
